stock.sub: 62% houses, character and contemporary mixed, with townhouses filling in (2021 Census)

green_space.sub: Pocket parks along the ridge; Quinn's Street Park has the fenced dog off-leash

stations.name: Morningside railway station
stations.walk_minutes_note: Closest station for southern Balmoral streets.

buses.note: Route 230 (Balmoral to City via Riding Road) and route 235 (via Thynne Road) serve the suburb (TransLink, 15 Aug 2026; re-check stop lists before quoting).

driving.motorway_access: Story Bridge for the CBD. Gateway Motorway via the Cannon Hill interchange.
driving.approx_cbd_minutes_offpeak_note: Approximately 9 to 13 minutes to Brisbane CBD off-peak.

connections: Walk to the Bulimba and Hawthorne CityCat terminals from northern and western streets
Walking access to Oxford Street Bulimba from many addresses

primary_state.name: Bulimba State School (no state primary inside Balmoral; 'Balmoral State School' does not exist)

secondary_state.name: Balmoral State High School
secondary_state.note: The state high school is located within the suburb and is the common catchment for many surrounding inner-east addresses.

private_nearby.name: Sts Peter and Paul's Catholic School

parks: Six pocket parks (Fisherman's Bend, Andrew St, Kuranda St, Pollock St, Quinn's St, Suvla Bay)
Quinn's Street Park fenced dog off-leash
lifestyle.shops_dining_note: The Riding Road strip is Balmoral's own corner: Little Hideout at 185, Willow Cafe and FRANKIE4 at 216. Oxford Street Bulimba and the Hawthorne Garage precinct are within walking distance for many streets. Daily groceries through Bulimba Plaza.

pockets.name: River-view ridge
pockets.character: The elevated spine with river and city outlooks (Balmoral does not touch the river itself). Character queenslanders, premium family-home market, ferry walk from the northern edge.

pockets.name: Bulimba boundary
pockets.character: Streets along the boundary with Bulimba. Often debated as Bulimba or Balmoral by buyers depending on which side of the line.

pockets.name: Hawthorne-adjacent
pockets.character: Southern Balmoral streets bordering Hawthorne. Similar character stock and lifestyle access.

buyer_profile.note: Families targeting the catchment combination and the riverside lifestyle. Largest segment in the suburb.
Buyers moving up from Norman Park or Morningside for river access and the inner-east village strip access.
Long-term inner-east owners moving to smaller character homes or townhouses to remain close to the strip and the river.

pois.name: Balmoral State High School
pois.note: The in-suburb state high on the Thynne and Lytton corner, since 1958

pois.name: 276 Riding Road
pois.note: c.1890 Queenslander on the local heritage list

pois.name: Bulimba Memorial Bowls Club
pois.note: On Quinn Street, inside Balmoral despite the name

pois.name: 216 Riding Road strip
pois.note: Willow Cafe and the FRANKIE4 flagship

pois.name: Kuranda Street Park
pois.note: One of the six ridge pocket parks
